_fiction_notice: EVERY finding, unit, figure, date and locator in this file is FICTIONAL. Cedar Hollow Regional Authority does not exist. These are illustrative fixtures for work order UIOWA-081 and contain no University of Iowa data, findings, systems or measurements.
_source_label: Cedar Hollow Regional Authority (FICTIONAL) - assessment findings register, draft

findings.title: Incident records retained with a named owner
findings.observed: Incident records are retained for all 5 units in scope, and every closed incident in the sampled period carried a named owner.

evidence.locator: incident register export, all units, sampled period

findings.title: Data ownership documented in one unit
findings.observed: One unit described a documented owner for each system feeding its reporting pipeline. The practice was not observed or corroborated elsewhere.
unresolved: Whether the same documentation exists in the other 4 units - not examined.
Whether the documented owners are current - the register's last review date was not available.

findings.title: Review path for AI-assisted outputs
findings.observed: No review path for AI-assisted outputs was established during the assessment window. Neither the presence nor the absence of one was confirmed.
unresolved: Whether any unit reviews AI-assisted output before it takes effect - UNKNOWN.
Who would own such a review path if it exists - UNKNOWN.
This finding has NO evidence attached and cannot support any assertion. It is carried so that the gap is visible, not so that it can be summarized.

findings.title: Same-day triage in the units reviewed
findings.observed: In the 2 of 5 units where intake was reviewed, requests were triaged within the same working day.
unresolved: Triage timing in the remaining 3 units - not reviewed.

findings.title: Corrective actions recorded but not tracked to completion
findings.observed: Corrective actions were recorded at closure in 4 of 5 units, and in none of those units was there a mechanism that tracked whether the action was completed.
unresolved: Practice in the remaining unit - not reviewed.

findings.title: Documented refresh schedule for catalogued reference data
findings.observed: A documented refresh schedule covers 31% of catalogued reference datasets, consistently across all 5 units in scope.

evidence.locator: data catalogue export with schedule column

unresolved: Whether the uncovered 69% are intentionally static or simply unscheduled - UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Deliberately malformed record (hostile-input probe)
findings.observed: Present on purpose. Its severity value is outside the declared vocabulary, so it must be rejected at load and named -- never repaired with a default, because a repaired finding becomes citable.
